title: FairEHR-CLP: Towards Fairness-Aware Clinical Predictions with Contrastive Learning in Multimodal Electronic Health Records
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to algorithmic fairness in healthcare, which is a core component of AI ethics. It proposes and evaluates a new fairness metric, the Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI), specifically to benchmark and improve the ethical performance of clinical predictive models.
